items.topic: Catalog entries: descriptions + Mermaid only, no CLI/GraphQL
items.claim: Catalog entries previously could hold GraphQL, CLI commands, judo.sh, recipes
items.fact: Catalog entries contain only abstract descriptions and Mermaid. No GraphQL, no CLI commands, no judo.sh, no recipes or command lists anywhere in the repo (not even outside the catalog). Lint fails any CLI command line in an entry. CLI docs are linked (--help, --schema, CLI repo skills), never copied.

Each model-shaped entry declares fragment:<id>; fragments/<id>.model is a small ESM model (Sandbox base + package bp::<id>, neutral names), built only with CLI commands and saved with `save`. Diagram generated by `mermaid model -m fragments/<id>.model --scope bp::<id> --split none` between <!-- mermaid:generated fragment=<id> cli=<version> --> markers. Behaviour diagrams (stateDiagram-v2, sequenceDiagram) stay hand-written since the CLI draws only class diagrams. Rationale: model data has no command syntax to go stale.

items.topic: Fragment gate = validate --strict + render diff + scope check
items.claim: Gate rebuilt each fragment via the reconstruction tools (recon.sh, rebuild.py)
items.fact: Gate (judo-model-mermaid/scripts/check) per fragment: 1) `validate --strict` (model constraints, UI derivation, dry-run transform), 2) fresh `mermaid model` render must equal the generated block in the entry, 3) diagram may contain only elements from bp::<id> plus <<external>> stubs. Runs after sweep, distillation, on PRs and releases. Only the released pinned CLI jar is used; 'built only through CLI' is an authoring rule, PR shows `save` change summary.

items.topic: Reconstruction tools are not part of the CLI
items.claim: Agent planned to depend on model-reconstruction skill (recon.sh describe/seed/plan/compare, rebuild.py) and a JUDO_CLI_REPO checkout in the gate
items.fact: Operator: 'reconstruction tools????'. model-reconstruction is a dev-time skill inside the CLI repo, not part of the released CLI; depending on it means cloning the CLI repo in CI and compiling Java. Remove all recon/rebuild/seed/volatile/JUDO_CLI_REPO from the plan; use only the released pinned jar.

judo-model-cli develop @9f6a4bd (2026-11-03, 1.1.0-SNAPSHOT) has `mermaid model` with --scope, --depth, --split (none|aggregate|package), --kinds (entity,enum,transfer,actor,operation), --members (none|types|...), --md; draws in-memory model, shows composition/aggregation/inheritance/enums/transfer objects/actors/multiplicities, stubs out-of-scope elements as <<external>>. Editing commands: create -t <Type> --ns <parent>, update, fill, relocate, move, split; each is one transaction with --dry-run, --schema for fields, `fix` hints. Also validate --strict, save, status, discard, query esm. CLI repo has judo-cli skill (docs at .pi/skills/judo-cli/docs/commands/*.md). Size warning: renderers refuse >~500 edges / 50000 chars; CLI prints `warn diagram model has N classes / M edges` with fix hint: narrow with --scope, --split aggregate, or --members none.

items.topic: Glimpse the whole model with mermaid model
items.fact: `judo-cli -q -m model.model mermaid model --md [opts]` without --scope prints the whole model (about 2 s on rackinspect.model, 95 entities/35 enums/62 compositions/6 inheritance, 18 aggregate sections plus standalone, transfer objects, actors, enumerations). Views: shape `--members none` ~6.5k tokens; domain `--members types` (default) ~10.5k tokens; access `--split package --kinds transfer,actor --members none` ~21k tokens; everything `--kinds entity,enum,transfer,actor,operation` ~48k tokens (too big). Read shape first, then domain, then zoom `--scope <Aggregate> --depth 1` or `query esm`. Standalone jar: judo-ng/runtime/judo-model-cli/target/judo-model-cli-1.1.0-SNAPSHOT-standalone.jar.

items.topic: Sweep starts with model overview + custom-code inventory
items.fact: Sweep (design D10) first generates shape.md, domain.md, access.md, counts.txt (model-overview) and custom.md (custom-overview), then analyses. Candidate = model shape plus the custom code it relies on (e.g. header/line aggregate + range interceptor + row-highlighting hook); repeating customizations (guarded writes, custom form actions) become frontend/backend best-practice candidates. Overview files are NEVER committed (repo is public, contain client names/code): written to gitignored target/sweep/<project>/<sha>/; PR body and PROJECTS.md get only counts and neutral-name candidates; redact-check runs on both. Task 1.5 adds target/ to .gitignore.

items.topic: Where JUDO project custom code lives (rackinspect conventions)
items.fact: Interceptors: application/interceptors/src, Java classes `implements OperationCallInterceptor` (66; methods getName, ignoreDecoratedCall, preCall, postCall(EOperation, parameterPayload, returnPayload)) annotated `@Component(property={"judo.model.name=<model>"})` or with service=OperationCallInterceptor.class. Guards: `implements WriteGuard` (11; permitted() -> Set<ActorRole>, operations() -> List<String>, preCall). Custom backend operation code in application/app/src/main/java/.... Custom frontend: application/frontend-react/<app>/src/custom/ (application-customizer.tsx registers ~275 register*Hook and ~63 register*CustomImplementation calls, matched to pages via generated interface keys like KEY *_ACTIONS_HOOK; hooks/ dirs ViewEditActionHooks, FormActionsHooks, TableRowHighlightingHooks, containers, custom-implementations; components/). Generator overrides: application/frontend-react/generator-overrides/ui-react/actor/public/... (e.g. i18n/application_default_extra.fragment.hbs).

ctx_execute python with large heredoc edit scripts got truncated/failed; write the edit script to /tmp/*.py with the write tool and run it with bash. Run `openspec validate <change> --strict`; requirements >500 chars trigger a warning (move detail into scenarios, split requirements). kb guard nags 'Repeated source searching, still no kb consult' - run kb_search before bulk source searching.
